prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic portrait of an approved adult man casually posed with a vintage red Jeep in bright tropical daylight.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with naturally messy dark hair and sunglasses, wearing a relaxed white linen shirt, dark brown trousers, and a smartwatch. He leans or sits casually against the red Jeep while looking to the side with a bold confident attitude.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium-full portrait with the red Jeep clearly visible behind or beside the subject, palm trees and open sky in the background, and a relaxed fashion-editorial stance.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daylight with wind movement, dark-green cinematic color grade, strong confident tropical atmosphere, realistic linen and vehicle texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic 8K-style digital photography, vertical framing, sharp subject and Jeep, natural depth of field, accurate hands and vehicle geometry.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic vertical cinematic portrait of an approved adult man with naturally messy dark hair and sunglasses beside a vintage red Jeep in bright tropical daylight. Dress him in a relaxed white linen shirt, dark brown trousers, and a smartwatch. Let him lean or sit casually against the Jeep while looking to the side with a bold confident attitude. Include palm trees and open sky, wind movement, dark-green cinematic grading, realistic linen and vehicle textures, and natural depth of field.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, warped vehicle
